note: Only add an item here after it passes the shop gates: real supplier mockup of the exact colorway, lining/inside color checked, art at print resolution, product URL returns 200 signed out. Customer-facing fields (name, alt, meta, cta, collection blurbs, stores[].carries) must not name third-party blank brands; put those in the internal blank field. Run: node tools/check-shop-links.mjs

collections.name: Local Icons
collections.blurb: One small embroidered icon and the letters locals read right away: WB, CB, KB, ILM. Real stitching on garment-dyed crewnecks, corduroy caps and cuffed beanies, no big prints.

collections.name: Heritage Varsity
collections.blurb: Town names and the ILM airport code in classic varsity lettering on garment-dyed crewnecks, hoodies and tees.

collections.name: Locals' Christmas
collections.blurb: Christmas on the Carolina coast. Gifts and stocking stuffers for Wilmington locals and everyone who wishes they were at the beach.

collections.name: Landmark Prints
collections.blurb: The fishing piers, the Carolina Beach boardwalk and the battleship as vintage travel posters on museum-matte paper, plus an embroidered Airlie Oak crewneck.

collections.name: Coastal Classics
collections.blurb: The pennant dad hat and garment-dyed tees in quiet coastal colors, each with a small, understated mark.

collections.name: Salt & Sea Oats
collections.blurb: Hand-painted watercolor sloops on a garment-dyed tee and an oversized organic crewneck.

collections.name: Tide Line
collections.blurb: An organic cotton tote for the boat, the beach and the market run.

collections.name: Shore Gear
collections.blurb: Surf, tennis, pickleball and golf tees, a market tote and town can coolers.

collections.name: Boardwalk
collections.blurb: The Carolina Beach Boardwalk tee, garment-dyed, with a sea glass wave.

collections.name: Harbor Capsules
collections.blurb: Themed capsule sets, made to order.

collections.name: Beach Setup
collections.blurb: The chair, the shade, the towel and the cooler. Everything for a full day on Wrightsville, Carolina Beach or Kure.

item_fields: id, collection, name, url (https product page on one of the stores[] hosts), img, alt, meta, cta, price (number, USD, lowest variant price), from (optional boolean, true when the price varies by option so the page prints From $X), scenes[] (beach|boardwalk|riverwalk|harbor-night), cut (optional, unisex), store (shopify|fourthwall), buy (optional https cart permalink for one-tap checkout), studio (optional product shot url, not shown on the shop page yet), lookbook (styled image url), blank (optional, internal only: supplier blank brand and model, never rendered on the page)

stores.name: ShoreList Gear
stores.carries: Art prints, printed tees, crewnecks, totes and the dad hat

stores.name: ShoreList Shop
stores.carries: Embroidered and varsity apparel, beach gear, can coolers and ornaments

stores_note: Both stores are live: the Shopify store carries the embroidered and varsity apparel, beach gear, can coolers and ornaments and feeds the on-site bag; the second store carries the art prints, printed tees, two crewnecks, totes and the dad hat and checks out on its own site. The store links strip shows only when 2+ stores resolve to an allowed host. allowedHosts lists the exact store hosts (the page also accepts their subdomains); item url, buy and stores[].url are dropped by the page if their host is not listed. If the store domain changes (for example to shorelist.shop), update stores[].url, item urls, allowedHosts and the STORE constants in shop-cart.js and netlify/functions/shop-product.js together.
